product.description:
Iro Bed by Megapap made of PU leather with storage space, color white, 160x200cm

Refresh your bedroom or professional space by choosing the Iro bed and enjoy the most restful sleep. Its storage space will make your life easier, and you’ll never have to worry again about lacking room to store your belongings. The mattress is placed on two rows of anatomical slats that will offer you additional comfort so you can enjoy every moment of your sleep. The bed is entirely upholstered in high-quality PU leather. The headboard and footboard are upholstered with a tufted technique, adding a touch of luxury to your bedroom!

Technical characteristics:

  • Color: White
  • Bed dimensions: Length 217.5 x Depth 171 x Height 109 cm
  • Base height: 35 cm
  • Storage depth: 30 cm
  • Compatible with a 160x200 cm mattress (not included in the price).
  • Upholstered 100% with high-quality PU leather offering excellent durability and resistance over time.
  • Bed frame made of wood for greater strength and long-term durability.
  • Includes storage space under the slats.
  • The storage area consists of a fabric base attached to the bed with Velcro strips.
  • Equipped with a metal mechanism that lifts the slats.
  • Comes with anatomical slats.
  • Supported by wooden legs in black color.
  • Ideal for home or professional use, such as hotels and AirBnB rentals.
Notes:
The product is delivered unassembled, in factory packaging, and includes a detailed assembly guide.
The product’s color may slightly vary from its photographic depiction on your screen.
